highlight.title: Major Curriculum and Assessment Review Changes Announced
highlight.summary: <cite index="3-1,3-2">A major review of the curriculum and qualifications system has just been published, and the government is making changes based on what it found</cite>. <cite index="2-6,2-7">The review's final report was published in November 2025, and the government has confirmed a revised curriculum will be published in 2027, for first teaching in 2028</cite>.

resources.title: Oak National Academy - Updated KS3 Art & Design Curriculum
resources.why_now: Relevant for both students and parents as <cite index="20-1,20-2">Oak has just partnered with NSEAD to produce 16 new lessons for their Key Stage 3 (11-14 years) Art and Design curriculum, adding new artists to celebrate a wider selection of contemporary art</cite>.

resources.title: BBC Bitesize - New Spring Term GCSE Revision Resources
resources.why_now: Essential for GCSE students as <cite index="11-2,11-4,11-5">this spring term brings new exam revision resources covering French, Spanish, Religious Studies, Science, English Literature and Maths, plus new podcasts series including History of Medicine and GCSE English exam skills</cite>.

resources.title: DfE Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill - What Parents Need to Know
resources.why_now: Important for parents to understand as <cite index="1-14,1-15,1-16">the Bill will require all state-funded schools – including academies – to teach the national curriculum, meaning parents can be assured their child gets the reformed curriculum benefits no matter what type of school they attend</cite>.

resources.title: GCSE Formula Sheets Changes for 2026 Exams
resources.why_now: Critical for current Year 10/11 students as <cite index="30-13,30-14,30-16">from summer 2026, GCSE maths students will receive printed formula sheets, and Physics/Combined Science will include equation sheets, with these support materials published by September 2025</cite>.

claude_take: The biggest shake-up to UK education in over a decade is underway, with curriculum reform coming in 2028 alongside immediate changes like formula sheets for GCSE 2026. Parents should stay informed about these transitions while students can benefit from enhanced resources now available through BBC Bitesize and Oak National Academy.
